title: Manyhands JSON v1 pull-request closure mutation
description: The data of a result of ticket close in a pull-request repository, or of ticket withdraw-closure, or of an operation resume that continued one: a branch record that finished, whatever way. Nothing of it reaches primary, so it has no integration, cleanup or made-ready report. It carries the data in an ok, already_closing, already_applied, remote_branch_deleted or ticket_closed answer, and in the recovery_required answer of a record whose publication remote changed or is gone, whose way out is item sync. A prepare that is blocked answers with the lifecycle's blocked data instead, and a child of the record that stops carries the synchronization's own. It holds IDs, commits and fixed categories: no closed_by, title or body.

action.description: What the record did to the ticket: close records or keeps a closure on the ticket's branch; new_branch makes the branch again from primary after its old one was deleted on the remote, keeping a provisional closure; withdraw removes a closure from the branch.

closure.description: The closure the answer leaves on the branch. recording is recorded when this record wrote it, existing when the branch already held it (every already_closing answer reads existing), withdrawn when this record removed it, and none when the record wrote or kept none. closed_at is the closure's own timestamp, set exactly when recording is recorded, and null otherwise. closed_by is never here: it is personal data.

checkpoint_oid.description: The commit this record made on the ticket's branch, when it made one.

publication.description: How the ticket's branch reached the remote: published when this record pushed it, current when the remote held it already. Null when the record's publication did not complete.

retired_context.description: The commit a new branch retired of the old context: its old tip, or the remote history's last published commit. Null for any other record.

pull_request.description: Where to open the pull request, from the link record. Null when the item has none.

blockers.description: What stands in the way, as a blocked prepare names it. Empty otherwise.
